learned_rules:
- **The money shape rates 8, or 9 if the radar shows the narrative still climbing:** MIGRATED volume leader 25–45% off its local high, higher-low base printed above the hourly low, 5m vol ≥ $10k and ≥ hourly pace (1h/12), more buys than sells, top 10 under 15%, low RugCheck bundles. CATBOT (4.44x) and FLOATER (2.19x) were both this shape, and they're my only real winners (V1, V6, V13).
- **MIGRATED buy zone is 10–60% off the local high** (owner). Within 10% is a PASS, blocker "chasing" (skips: 7 ran, 43 dumped).
- **The shallow band (10–25% off) is a breakout trade, capped at 7:** it has to be the volume leader, pushing into the high now, with flow at or above pace. Otherwise PASS, blocker "no breakout" (0 for 4).
- **A spike is chasing anywhere in the zone:** last 5m candle up >25% or 5m vol >3x hourly pace means wait for a retrace and a printed higher low. Blocker "chasing spike" (PILLSEY, V1).
- **Flow below pace is a PASS, never a probe.** Blocker "flow below pace" (HYPERCHAN, BLUE, AAPLCAT were bought below pace and none went green).
- **Rate on the first resistance:** nearest prior high/POC/0.618 ≥1.5x above entry can rate 8–9; at 1.3–1.5x it's capped at 7, and I sell half on a rejection there; under 1.3x is a PASS, blocker "target too close".
- **A migration under 1h old that's still bleeding off its bond spike waits for a base above the hourly low.** Blocker "too new" (skips: 4 ran, 45 dumped; SI, V1).
- **Vamp field: buy only the leader by 5m volume and radar mentions.** A bundle cluster inside a big same-ticker field is a PASS, blocker "split crowd" (BLUE, V1, V3).
- **A DIP needs a printed higher low:** bounce off the hourly low, pull back while holding above it, then reclaim the pullback high. Never buy the first red-to-green candle. A close under the higher low means sell (HEXN x2, SIS, AAPLCAT).
- **DIP gate:** 5m vol ≥0.7x the hourly average, 40–70% drawdown, story still on the radar. A thin tech/LARP dip is a PASS, blocker "dead story". If the catalyst already printed, it's capped at 6 until it reclaims the pullback high. A DIP rates 8+ only with the full money shape (DIPs are 0 for 5).
- **Hard blocks:** top 10 >25%, dev >1%, bundles or insiders over the line, mint/freeze live, LP not burned, political figure, RugCheck danger or not loading, any hack/exploit/drain story (V6, V13, V17, owner). Every one of these skip groups mostly dumped.
- **Never-green cut:** if a trade hasn't printed 1.05x by 10 minutes and 5m vol is under the hourly pace, sell at market. Don't wait for a stop that gaps to −30% or worse.
- **Protect green trades before initials:** green, and 5m vol under half the hourly pace, means sell half. Time stop at the clock if under 1.0x with no volume surge; one extension to 90 min only if mcap >$1M, ≥1.08x on mcap, holding the range low and flow at or above pace (V1).
- **A stop review defaults to SELL, right away:** always sell if it never went green, the reason is "unclear", it already touched 1.3x, or top-10/insider share dropped while price bleeds (8 of 8 reviews closed worse than the stop). Hold once only if the bundle share dropped, it went green first and flow is at or above pace. Re-enter a stopped coin only on a reclaim of its prior high.
